summary: Track 25A UX unification pass tested end-to-end. All 10 Admin OS domain landings reachable, AdminBreadcrumb present with correct data-testids on every surface, both crumb-0 links navigate back to /admin, OCC now uses PortalShell+SideNavV3 (same MASCI · Admin header, same left nav, no bespoke orange 'Platform Operations' header), occ-back-adminos button works, snapshot export button present, tablet breadcrumb wraps cleanly, zero console errors. Two residual operator-facing V2 leftovers found on the Communications surface + AdminOS home card that Track 25A said should be gone.

ui_bugs.issue: Card body still contains operator-facing V2 language: 'Mode v2 · 49 routes · 0 critical' as the status summary AND action guidance 'Last V2 audit ...'. Sprint 25A explicitly required removing '(v2)' operator-facing labels — the parenthesised (v2) is gone, but 'Mode v2' and 'Last V2 audit' remain in the card content.
The Communications card on /admin shows a big 'V2' as the card's headline value (analogous to '50', '0%', '4/6' on sibling cards). Operator sees 'V2' front and centre on the Admin OS landing.

Sources footer prints raw endpoint paths like '/api/admin/email-routing/v2/status' — arguably a versioned API path is not operator-facing V2 branding, but it is visible to operators and matches the spirit of the cleanup rule. Consider hiding raw endpoint paths or aliasing them.

action_items: AdminCommunications Email Routing card: replace 'Mode v2 · 49 routes · 0 critical' with 'Mode current · 49 routes · 0 critical' (or drop the mode field entirely). Replace 'Last V2 audit' action text with 'Last email audit'.
AdminOS home Communications card: change the headline value from 'V2' to something operator-meaningful ('49 routes', 'Healthy', or count), or drop the version letter altogether.
Optional: alias/hide '/api/admin/email-routing/v2/status' in the operator-facing Sources footer.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminBreadcrumb component is clean, small, reusable, and correctly renders testids '<prefix>' and '<prefix>-crumb-<i>' — matches spec exactly.

OCC PortalShell wrapping is a large structural change but the Trust Center panel, filter row, ALL/CRITICAL/ATTENTION/UNKNOWN/HEALTHY pills, Maintenance Operations Console, audit panel + Refresh button all render intact.
Only remaining V2 leakage is content-side (card copy + headline value), not shell-side — Track 25A's shell unification goal is met.
